column1: # Go≡Rust equivalence classification — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which
# examples the equiv-sweep compares. EVERY top-level dir under examples/ MUST
# appear here exactly once. An example present on disk but absent here is
# "unclassified" → equiv-sweep FAILS and "Go parity maintained" CANNOT be claimed
# (sky-rust-backend:keep-go-parity inherits this gate by always running equiv-sweep).
# Format:  <example>  <in|out>  <reason>
#   in   = stdout is deterministic AND backend-independent → a diff is a real bug.
#   out  = a diff there would be a legitimate Go/Rust difference, not a regression.
# When a new example lands, CLASSIFY IT here (in or out, with a reason) — that is
# the forced-classification step. Do not leave it unclassified.
00-standard-libs        in   120 stdlib assertions; pass/fail lines are deterministic + backend-independent
01-hello-world          in   plain deterministic output
04-local-pkg            in   multi-module; deterministic
06-json                 in   encode/decode; object key order is _fieldIndex-stable on both backends
14-task-demo            in   sequential Task andThen/fail/run; deterministic
35-composite-generics   in   generics demo; deterministic
simple                  in   task_sequence/parallel — results collected then printed in order
test_pkg                in   Result/Maybe combinators; deterministic
02-go-stdlib            out  Go-FFI only — does not build on --target rust (nothing to compare)
03-tea-external         out  does not build on --target rust
05-mux-server           out  server + does not build on --target rust
07-todo-cli             out  interactive (reads stdin commands) — not a one-shot
08-notes-app            out  server (Sky.Http.Server) — no deterministic stdout
09-live-counter         out  Sky.Live — no stdout; console in-process(Go) vs cross-process child(Rust)

18-job-queue            out  Sky.Live — no stdout
19-skyforum             out  Sky.Live — no stdout
